(* substantial presence test: 7701(b)(3)(A) — 31+ days this year AND weighted 3-year sum >= 183 *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_prior_year_1 : int) (days_prior_year_2 : int) : bool =
  let weighted_sum =
    (float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0) +.
    (float_of_int days_prior_year_1 *. (1.0 /. 3.0)) +.
    (float_of_int days_prior_year_2 *. (1.0 /. 6.0))
  in
  days_current_year >= 31 && weighted_sum >= 183.0

(* B: exception to substantial presence test (A) - present <183 days this year, tax home abroad, closer connection to that country *)
let has_closer_connection_exception (days_current_year : int) (sec_911_d_3 : bool) (* cross-ref: §911(d)(3) *) (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool) : bool =
  days_current_year < 183 && sec_911_d_3 && has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country

(* C: exception to (B) - closer connection exception unavailable if adjustment-of-status or LPR steps taken during year *)
let closer_connection_exception_inapplicable (has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool) (took_other_steps_toward_lawful_permanent_residence : bool) : bool =
  has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application || took_other_steps_toward_lawful_permanent_residence

(* D: exception - a day is not counted as present if individual is exempt or medically unable to leave *)
let is_excluded_presence_day (is_exempt_individual : bool) (unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_while_present : bool) : bool =
  is_exempt_individual || unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_while_present

module Substantial_presence_test = struct
  let meets_substantial_presence_test = meets_substantial_presence_test

  let closer_connection_exception_inapplicable = closer_connection_exception_inapplicable
  let is_excluded_presence_day = is_excluded_presence_day
end
